title: Introduction: Vitae, the Loquacious Logbook
description: A magnanimous greeting to you, dear reader; I am Vitae, the magical survival guide, and I will assist you on this journey.
As you complete more of my objectives, I will populate with helpful lessons and tips that should help you survive on the island you find yourself on.
Be aware, reader, that I have limited ink, so any deviation from these objectives will not be dignified with a response.
Now! Tout de suite! Affirm to me that you've "Read" all this, and we can be off to the races!
